detail.longDescription: I am trying to build my frontend in my turborepo monorepo with Docker. When I run docker-compose up --build in the terminal, I get an "Error 404 Not Found - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@repo%2Feslint-config" . It goes on to say: "@repo/eslint-config@*' is not in this registry." I am working on a Linux operating system using Debian 15.19. How can I fix my frontend Dockerfile so that I can avoid this error? My project is structured like this: my_project -.turbo --cache -apps --database --server --desktop_client ---app ---public ---.gitignore ---Dockerfile ---eslint.config.js ---next-env.d.ts ---next.config.js ---package.json ---README.md ---tsconfig.json -node_modules -packages --eslint-config ---base.js ---next.js ---package.json ---react-internal.js ---README.md --typescript-config --ui -.dockerignore -.env -.gitignore -.npmrc -docker-compose.yml -package-lock.json -package.json -README.md -turbo.json My frontend Dockerfile looks like this. I get the error on RUN npm install --omit=dev : FROM node:20-slim WORKDIR /apps/desktop_client COPY . . RUN npm install --omit=dev CMD ["node", "page.tsx"] EXPOSE 3000 This is my docker-compose.yml : version: '3.8' services: database: build: ./apps/database ports: - "5432:5432" environment: - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD} volumes: - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data server: build: ./apps/server ports: - "8000:8000" depends_on: - database desktop_client: build: ./apps/desktop_client ports: - "3000:3000" depends_on: - server volumes: pgdata: The database and server build successfully, it's just the frontend that is not building. My package.json in my frontend folder (called "desktop_client") looks like this: { "name": "desktop_client", "version": "0.1.0", "type": "module", "private": true, "scripts": { "dev": "next dev --port 3000", "build": "next build", "start": "next start", "lint": "eslint --max-warnings 0", "check-types": "next typegen && tsc --noEmit" }, "dependencies": { "@repo/ui": "*", "bootstrap": "^5.3.8", "decimal.js": "^10.6.0", "next": "16.3.4", "react": "19.2.8", "react-bootstrap": "^2.10.10", "react-dom": "19.2.8" }, "devDependencies": { "@repo/eslint-config": "*", "@repo/typescript-config": "*", "@types/node": "26.4.1", "@types/react": "19.2.18", "@types/react-dom": "19.2.5", "eslint": "10.9.1", "typescript": "7.0.2" } } My package.json file at the root of my project looks like this: { "name": "my-fullstack-monorepo", "private": true, "scripts": { "build": "turbo run build", "dev": "turbo run dev", "lint": "turbo run lint", "format": "prettier --write \"**/*.{ts,tsx,md}\"", "check-types": "turbo run check-types" }, "devDependencies": { "prettier": "3.9.6", "turbo": "^2.10.12", "typescript": "7.0.2" }, "engines": { "node": ">=24" }, "devEngines": { "packageManager": { "name": "npm", "version": "10.9.2" } }, "workspaces": [ "apps/*", "packages/*" ] } And my packages referenced in those workspaces above include an eslint-config folder with this package.json : { "name": "@repo/eslint-config", "version": "0.0.0", "type": "module", "private": true, "exports": { "./base": "./base.js", "./next-js": "./next.js", "./react-internal": "./react-internal.js" }, "devDependencies": { "@babel/core": "8.0.1", "@babel/eslint-parser": "8.0.1", "@babel/preset-typescript": "8.0.1", "@eslint/js": "10.0.1", "@next/eslint-plugin-next": "16.3.4", "eslint": "10.9.1", "eslint-config-prettier": "10.1.8", "eslint-plugin-only-warn": "1.2.1", "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "7.1.1", "eslint-plugin-turbo": "2.10.12", "globals": "17.12.0" } } In my package-lock.json at the root of my project, I have a key-value pair for "packages/eslint-config" that looks like this: "packages/eslint-config": { "name": "@repo/eslint-config", "version": "0.0.0", "devDependencies": { "@babel/core": "8.0.1", "@babel/eslint-parser": "8.0.1", "@babel/preset-typescript": "8.0.1", "@eslint/js": "10.0.1", "@next/eslint-plugin-next": "16.3.4", "eslint": "10.9.1",
